The ring stays exactly as in the first frame: same ropes, canvas and on-screen graphics bar. Do not invent or re-spell any text, no gibberish, no logos of any other fight promotion. Photorealistic, correct anatomy, no morphing. Comedic tone, deadpan. Audio: a huge arena crowd murmuring and building, a few whistles, then the crowd starting to laugh and roar. No music, no commentary, no speech.
